prompt:
You are an expert Python programmer.
Your task is to implement the function described below.
Do not write a main block, test cases, or explanatory text.
Return only the Python code for the function.

Task:
Implement the function `generate_post(title, content)` that returns an HTML page containing the given
title and content.

The returned string must have the structure:
<html><head><title>...</title></head><body>...</body></html>

Any characters in `title` and `content` that would otherwise be interpreted as HTML markup must be
represented as literal text in the returned HTML.

Note: The implementation should raise an appropriate exception when it cannot complete the task successfully.

-----Examples-----
Input:
title = "This is a book title."
content = "This book is about a dog."
generate_post(title, content)
Output:
"<html><head><title>This is a book title.</title></head><body>This book is about a dog.</body></html>"

Function name: generate_post
output:
def generate_post(title, content):
    import html

    if not isinstance(title, str) or not isinstance(content, str):
        raise TypeError("title and content must be strings")

    safe_title = html.escape(title, quote=True)
    safe_content = html.escape(content, quote=True)

    return f"<html><head><title>{safe_title}</title></head><body>{safe_content}</body></html>"
